# The Brass Astrolabe

## Overview

Recovered from the top of [[Cinder Steps]], dry, in the open.

## Description

Brass, unmarked, and set for a latitude that is not [[The Fold]]'s.

## Recovery (Session 4)

Taken without resistance. [[Sister Ilva]] watched and said nothing.

## Connections

- [[Cinder Steps]]
- [[Petra Vance]]

## Notes

Nobody has established what it is for, which has not stopped the crew carrying it.
